MYCPE ONE: Combining innovation and expertise to provide accounting firms with comprehensive solutions, enhancing efficiency, profitability, and growth. 

About Us

The MYCPE One Story

MYCPE ONE is driven by a shared vision to redefine professional growth and
streamline business solutions for accounting firms. 

2014

Entigrity (Now merged to MYCPE ONE) began operations in Ahmedabad, India, co-founded by Shalin (Shawn) and Valay Parikh. Signed the first client, JE Owens & Company, on December 31st.

2015

Shawn moved to the US and established an office in Wantagh, NY.

2018

Entigrity expanded into a 100-member team. 

2019

Opened an office in Toronto to expand operations in Canada. 

Signed the 100th client. 

MYCPE Started with a dream and a team of 4. 

MYCPE Launched platform CPA Continuing Education Courses

Content Available only in live Webinars with Pay per course model.

2020

Shawn was named a Top 20 Under 40 Accounting Influencer by CPA Practice Advisor. 

MYCPE Launched Enrolled Agent, CMA, CIA, and Continuing Education.

Introduced On-Demand content—learning anytime, anywhere!

2021

Opened an office in London to cater to UK accounting firms.  

The Gujarat office expanded to the city of Baroda. 

Shawn was again recognized as a Top 20 Under 40 Accounting Influencer for the second consecutive year.

Entered the HR domain with SHRM and HRCI qualifications.

Rolled out annual packages and advanced certifications for deeper expertise.

50+ expert instructors joined forces to deliver top-notch content. 

2022

Expanded Indian operations to 4 new cities: Kochi, Rajkot, Jaipur, and Indore. 

MOU signed with the Gujarat State Government to invest 1,500 million rupees in upskilling professionals and generating additional employment for up to 2,000 professionals.   

MOU established with the Kerala State Government and ASAP Kerala to create 500 jobs and establish an office in the state. 

Partnered with IMA (Institute of Management of Accountant US) to become their first platinum partner with plans to upskill 5,000 professionals in U.S. accounting standards.

Became BDO Partner to serve alliance member accounting firms.

Shawn was recognized as a Top 20 Under 40 Accounting Influencer for the third consecutive year.

CA Expanded into Canada with qualifications like CPA Canada and FP Canada. 

Added Payroll designations, bringing more professionals into the MY-CPE fold. 

Transitioned to a subscription- for Individuals and Teams. 

2023

Expanded operations to 8 new Indian cities: Chandigarh, Nagpur, Nashik, Lucknow, Ranchi, Surat, Kolkata, and Vijayawada. 

Received SOC Type 2 compliance certification. 

Awarded Dream Company to Work For and Best Employer Brand by Times Ascent. 

Valay Parikh was named Times Man of the Year in the Entrepreneur category. 

Launched the Entigrity Academy, a non-profit educational initiative offering free EA coaching. 

Serving 75+ qualifications, solidifying our global footprint. 

Launched advanced compliance tools and Mobile App.

500+ content creators, ensuring diverse and cutting-edge content. 

2024

Honored with the Education & Empowering Communities Award at The CSR Journal Excellence Awards. 

Shawn was awarded by CPA Practice Advisor as a Top 20 Under 40 Accounting Influencer. (4th consecutive year) 

Entigrity was certified as a Great Place to Work® and awarded KPO Company and Dream Employer of the Year by Times Ascent. 

Partnered with Boomer Consulting. 

Opened a Corporate Office - ATULYAKSH. 

Opened a New Office in GIFT City, Gandhinagar. 

15,000+ hours of content, available on MYCPE platform.

Expanded to 100+ qualifications. 

Launched the Learning and Compliance Management Systems. 

700+ content creators to deliver the highest quality content. 

3,000+ firms, government agencies, and enterprises. 

Crossed milestone of 250,000+ users

Entigrity merged its operations with MYCPE under one Umbrella - MYCPE ONE.
